summary.en: Pakistani security forces killed three TTP-linked terrorists, including the mastermind of the Kohat police lines attack, in an IBO operation on the outskirts of Peshawar. Security forces also killed 15 terrorists in Balochistan's Mastung district. An alleged rapist of a daughter was killed in a police encounter in Kot Addu. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker drepte tre TTP-tilknyttede terrorister, inkludert hjernen bak angrepet på politilinjen i Kohat, i en IBO-operasjon på utkanten av Peshawar. Sikkerhetsstyrkene drepte også 15 terrorister i Mastung-distriktet i Balochistan. En påstått voldtektsmann av en datter ble drept i en politimotstand i Kot Addu. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
